gacc_sections.narrative: * Lake Ranch, Oklahoma DOF. Twelve miles northwest of McAlester, OK. Grass and timber. Active fire behavior with wind-driven runs and torching. Cedar Hollow, Oklahoma DOF. Twelve miles northeast of Tahlequah, OK. Timber. Minimal fire behavior. Hydra, Texas A&M Forest Service. Three miles south of Meridian, TX. Brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Last report unless significant activity occurs.

Dome, Yosemite National Park, NPS. CIMT (CA Team 3). One mile north of Wawona, CA. Timber, brush and heavy slash. Moderate fire behavior with flanking, uphill runs and single tree torching. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Plaskett, Los Padres NF, USFS. CIMT (CA Team 6). CIMT is also managing the Timber incident. Thirty-four miles southwest of Big Sur, CA. Chaparral, grass and timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping. Area and trail closures in effect. Timber, Los Padres NF, USFS. Four miles southeast of Big Sur, CA. Grass, timber and chaparral. Moderate fire behavior with creeping, backing and uphill runs. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect.

Little Giant, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 13). CIMT is also managing the Sisi incident. Thirty miles northwest of Leavenworth, WA. Timber and dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. Structures threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Sisi, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. Ten miles northwest of Stehekin, WA. Closed timber litter and timber. Active fire behavior with backing, flanking and isolated torching. Residences and energy infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Austin, Mt. Hood NF, USFS. CIMT (CA Team 2). CIMT is also managing The Narrows and Grasshopper incidents. Twenty-five miles southeast of Estacada, OR. Brush, timber and closed timber litter. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering and creeping. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. The Narrows, Mt. Hood NF, USFS. Six miles east of Snoqualmie Pass, WA. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering and creeping. Numerous residences and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. Sinlahekin, Northeast Region, Washington DNR. One mile west of Tonasket, WA. Timber, brush and grass. predictive_services_discussion: Southwesterly winds 15-25 mph with gusts 30-40 mph will develop across northeast California into the northern Great Basin and southwest to central Montana today. Minimum relative humidity will be lowest from 10-20% from northern Nevada into central Montana with areas of elevated conditions expected. Breezy west winds will also occur in the Columbia Basin but will be accompanied by higher humidity above 30% and isolated to scattered showers. More widespread rainfall is expected near and west of the Cascades in Oregon and Washington, with wetting rain also expected in northern Idaho to western Montana. Warm and dry conditions are expected in southern California, but winds will be light outside the deserts. Widespread showers and scattered thunderstorms will continue in New Mexico, but areas of flooding are likely to be more localized than previous days. Above normal temperatures will continue in the southern Plains to Lower Mississippi Valley but with light winds and minimum relative humidity near or above 30%. A strong Nor’easter will develop off the Mid-Atlantic coast with strong northeast winds expected near the coast, with rain expected to spread into southern New England overnight. Areas of heavy rain are expected for the Big Island of Hawai’i and Maui as Hurricane Nolo approaches.
